construct_dense_grid: construct a dense 3D grid of vertices and cube indices from a given resolution on GPU
construct_voxel_grid: construct a voxel grid from sparse coordinates by computing unique vertices and cube connectivity
cubes_to_verts: scatter reduce per-cube feature values to per-vertex features using mean or sum reduction
sparse_cube2verts: convert sparse cube coordinates and features to vertex-level features with optional consistency loss
get_dense_attrs: map sparse voxel coordinates and features into a dense 3D attribute tensor with optional SDF initialization
